title: Correlation quadratic form
statement: For a real number $\rho$ and a point $t=(t_1,t_2)$ in the real correlation plane, the correlation quadratic form is $t_1^2+2\rho t_1t_2+t_2^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A point $t$ in the real correlation plane
